access_model: org-wide via Compliance Officer token + Events API (rolling ~90-day window)

endpoints.name: Get my own details
endpoints.purpose: Auth smoke-test; identifies the authenticated principal and its orgId.

endpoints.name: List events (org-wide message feed)
endpoints.purpose: PRIMARY content source. Org-wide feed of message activity; each created event's data is a message to index. Also yields updated (edits) and deleted (removals) events.
endpoints.pagination: Link header, rel="next", opaque cursor query param
endpoints.incremental_filter: from/to time window (bounded to ~90 days); cursor for paging within the window
endpoints.deletion_behavior: type=deleted events expose removed message ids within the window
endpoints.rate_limit_notes: 429 + Retry-After on throttle; auto-injects a from/to window if from omitted (default ~25 days)
endpoints.verified: live-probe HTTP 200; created/updated/deleted all 200; from beyond ~90d -> 403

endpoints.name: Get room details
endpoints.purpose: Fetch a discovered room's details (title, description, timestamps) for the Space document. Works org-wide with the compliance token.
endpoints.verified: live-probe HTTP 200 for a room id taken from an event

endpoints.name: List memberships
endpoints.purpose: For a discovered roomId, list members; drives per-document ACLs (allowed_users by email). Works org-wide with the compliance token.
endpoints.pagination: Link header, rel="next", opaque cursor query param

endpoints.name: List rooms (supporting)
endpoints.purpose: Supporting/diagnostic only. For a user token returns only the principal's spaces; NOT used for org-wide discovery (that comes from /events). Kept for reference and non-compliance fallback.
endpoints.pagination: Link header, rel="next", opaque cursor query param
